question.instructions: What is the plausible cadence of the named capability based only on its text description?

criteria.intraday: Normally occurs more than once per day
criteria.annual-or-rarer: Normally occurs annually or less often

question.instructions: Does the capability description indicate a regulated, statutory, contractual, or audit obligation?
Does the text indicate that an external system reads from or writes to this capability?
Does the human-authored text describe a workaround for this capability?
Which business process best matches this capability?

criteria.other: None of the named processes clearly fits

question.instructions: If deterministic rules establish that this capability is never used, what text-described reason best fits?

criteria.too-complex: Users avoid it because it is too difficult
criteria.duplicate: Another capability performs the same job
criteria.wrong-fit: It does not fit the actual process
criteria.unknown: The text does not establish a reason

question.instructions: How difficult does the text-described capability appear to replace?

criteria.trivial: A small deterministic transform or prompt
criteria.moderate: A bounded workflow with limited state
criteria.hard: Shared state, permissions, integrations, or transactional behavior
